name: Veil Masquerade #18
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Beaded veil. Aperture: Twin slits. Ornament: Stars. Palette: Gold + teal. Hem: Layered. Its hem is shared with one other in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
